entries.title: Predicting protein structures with a multiplayer online game
entries.authors: Cooper, Khatib, Treuille, Baker, Popović, et al.
entries.why: Canonical Foldit result: humans explore hard configuration spaces under an objective energy. Assurance Fold adapts that interaction pattern to evidence-package honesty, not protein physics.

entries.title: Why Most Published Research Findings Are False
entries.why: Motivates separating computational or statistical 'PASS' language from empirical truth. PCS keeps scientific adequacy explicitly open.

entries.title: Estimating the reproducibility of psychological science
entries.why: Large-scale empirical reminder that published claims need independent replay—not vibes.
